title: ReferralLinkRevoked
description: A provider revoked a referral link or QR (1.11.0, additive). Delivered to Kiorex through the Clinic outbox so the link registry stops treating the code as provider-led for NEW bookings; a still-valid signed `lt` of this code no longer decides PROVIDER_LED. Revocation can only remove a fee, never add one. Link code and organisation reference only: never patient data.

orgRef.description: Organisation (tenant) reference that owns the link code; the same value the signed `lt` carries as `o`. Additive in 1.11.0 on ReferralLinkCreated (optional there); required on ReferralLinkRevoked.

reason.description: Optional machine reason, e.g. PROVIDER_REQUEST, ABUSE, REPLACED.

product.description: Product the link or fact belongs to. Absent means CLINIC (1.11.0 behaviour). Additive in 1.12.0.

aggregateType.description: Injected by the Kiorly outbox; mirrors the envelope field.

aggregateId.description: Injected by the Kiorly outbox; mirrors the envelope field.
